standards.title: Hot Rolled Medium and High Tensile Structural Steel - Specification
standards.scope: Covers requirements for hot-rolled medium and high tensile structural steel grades E250, E275, E300, E350, E410, E450, E550, E650 for bridges, buildings, and general engineering purposes.

standards.title: High Strength Deformed Steel Bars and Wires for Concrete Reinforcement - Specification
standards.scope: Specifies requirements for high strength deformed steel bars and wires for concrete reinforcement in grades Fe 415, Fe 415D, Fe 500, Fe 500D, Fe 550, Fe 550D, Fe 600, Fe 650.

standards.title: Plain and Reinforced Concrete - Code of Practice
standards.scope: Deals with the general structural use of plain and reinforced concrete in buildings, bridges, and general structures. Specifies design procedures, durability requirements, and material properties.

standards.title: Ordinary Portland Cement - Specification
standards.scope: Covers manufacture and chemical/physical requirements of 33, 43, and 53 grades of ordinary Portland cement for concrete, mortar, and grouts.

standards.title: 43 Grade Ordinary Portland Cement - Specification
standards.scope: Covers manufacture and chemical and physical requirements of 43 grade ordinary Portland cement. Incorporated into IS 269:2015.

standards.title: 53 Grade Ordinary Portland Cement - Specification
standards.scope: Covers manufacture, chemical and physical requirements of 53 grade ordinary Portland cement for high-strength concrete applications. Incorporated into IS 269:2015.

standards.title: Coarse and Fine Aggregate for Concrete - Specification
standards.scope: Covers chemical and physical requirements for naturally sourced and manufactured coarse and fine aggregates for concrete, including recycled aggregates.

standards.title: High Density Polyethylene Pipes for Potable Water Supplies - Specification
standards.scope: Covers requirements for high density polyethylene (HDPE) pipes of sizes 16 mm to 1000 mm for potable water supplies, sewage, and industrial effluents.

standards.title: Steel Tubes for Structural Purposes - Specification
standards.scope: Covers requirements for hot finished and cold formed seamless and welded steel tubes for structural applications like trusses, columns, and space frames.

standards.title: Steel Tubes, Tubulars and Other Wrought Steel Fittings - Part 1: Steel Tubes
standards.scope: Covers requirements for welded and seamless steel tubes suitable for screwing to pipe threads, intended for water, gas, steam, and compressed air.

standards.title: Dimensions for Hot Rolled Steel Beam, Column, Channel and Angle Sections
standards.scope: Specifies nominal dimensions, mass, and sectional properties of hot-rolled steel beam, column, channel, and angle sections.

standards.title: Method of Tests for Strength of Concrete
standards.scope: Covers tests for determination of compressive strength, flexural strength, and modulus of elasticity of concrete cube and cylinder specimens.

standards.title: Methods of Sampling and Analysis of Concrete
standards.scope: Prescribes procedures for sampling of fresh concrete, measurement of workability (slump, compacting factor), and determination of air content.

standards.title: Metallic Materials - Tensile Testing at Ambient Temperature
standards.scope: Specifies the method for tensile testing of metallic materials and defines the mechanical properties which can be determined at ambient temperature.

standards.title: Metallic Materials - Bend Test
standards.scope: Specifies the method for determining the ability of metallic materials to undergo plastic deformation in bending.

standards.title: Information Technology Equipment - Safety - Part 1: General Requirements
standards.scope: Applies to mains-powered or battery-powered information technology equipment, including electrical business equipment and associated equipment, with a rated voltage not exceeding 600 V.

standards.title: Secondary Cells and Batteries Containing Alkaline or Other Non-Acid Electrolytes - Safety Requirements: Part 1 Nickel Systems
standards.scope: Specifies requirements and tests for the safe operation of portable sealed secondary nickel cells and batteries.

standards.title: Secondary Cells and Batteries Containing Alkaline or Other Non-Acid Electrolytes - Safety Requirements: Part 2 Lithium Systems
standards.scope: Specifies requirements and tests for the safe operation of portable sealed secondary lithium cells and batteries containing non-acid electrolyte, under intended use and reasonably foreseeable misuse.

standards.title: Audio, Video and Similar Electronic Apparatus - Safety Requirements
standards.scope: Applies to electronic apparatus designed to be fed from mains, from supply apparatus, from batteries or from remote power feeding and intended for reception, generation, recording or reproduction of audio, video and associated signals.

standards.title: Safety of Household and Similar Electrical Appliances - Part 1: General Requirements
standards.scope: Deals with the safety of electrical appliances for household and similar purposes, their rated voltage being not more than 250 V for single-phase appliances and 480 V for other appliances.

standards.title: Uninterruptible Power Systems (UPS) - Part 1: General and Safety Requirements for UPS
standards.scope: Applies to movable, stationary and fixed UPS for use in low-voltage distribution systems and that are intended to be installed in any operator accessible area.

standards.title: Plugs and Socket-Outlets for Related Voltages up to and Including 250 Volts and Rated Current up to and Including 16 Amperes - Specification
standards.scope: Applies to plugs and fixed or portable socket-outlets for a.c. only, with or without earthing contact, with a rated voltage above 50 V but not exceeding 250 V and a rated current not exceeding 16 A.

standards.title: Self-Ballasted LED Lamps for General Lighting Services - Part 1: Safety Requirements
standards.scope: Specifies the safety and interchangeability requirements, together with the test methods and conditions required to show compliance of LED lamps with integrated means for controlling.

standards.title: Self-Ballasted LED Lamps for General Lighting Services - Part 2: Performance Requirements
standards.scope: Specifies performance requirements for self-ballasted LED lamps for general lighting services, including luminous flux, efficacy, color temperature, and life.

standards.title: Luminaires - Part 5: Particular Requirements - Section 1: Fixed General Purpose Luminaires
standards.scope: Specifies requirements for fixed general purpose luminaires for use with tungsten filament, tubular fluorescent and other discharge lamps on supply voltages not exceeding 1000 V.

standards.title: Crystalline Silicon Terrestrial Photovoltaic (PV) Modules - Design Qualification and Type Approval
standards.scope: Lays down requirements for the design qualification and type approval of terrestrial crystalline silicon photovoltaic modules suitable for long-term operation in general open-air climates.

standards.title: Photovoltaic (PV) Module Safety Qualification - Part 1: Requirements for Construction
standards.scope: Describes the fundamental construction requirements for photovoltaic modules in order to provide safe electrical and mechanical operation during their expected lifetime.

standards.title: Polyvinyl Chloride Insulated Unsheathed and Sheathed Cables/Cords with Rigid and Flexible Conductor for Rated Voltages up to and Including 450/750 V
standards.scope: Specifies requirements for PVC insulated single-core and multi-core cables with copper or aluminium conductors for electric power and lighting.

standards.title: PVC Insulated (Heavy Duty) Electric Cables - Part 1: For Working Voltages up to and Including 1100 V
standards.scope: Covers requirements for PVC insulated and PVC sheathed armoured and unarmoured cables for electricity supply up to 1100 V.

standards.title: Crosslinked Polyethylene Insulated Thermoplastic Sheathed Cables - Specification: Part 1 For Working Voltage up to and Including 1100 V
standards.scope: Specifies requirements of XLPE insulated, PVC sheathed cables for electricity supply systems up to 1.1 kV.

standards.title: Specification for Industrial Safety Helmets
standards.scope: Specifies requirements for industrial safety helmets providing protection to the wearer against falling objects and other mechanical hazards in construction, mining, and manufacturing.

standards.title: Personal Protective Equipment - Part 2: Safety Footwear
standards.scope: Specifies basic and additional (optional) requirements for safety footwear used for general purpose, including mechanical risks, slip resistance, thermal risks, and ergonomic behavior.

standards.title: Respiratory Protective Devices - Filtering Half Masks to Protect Against Particles - Specification
standards.scope: Specifies minimum requirements for filtering half masks as respiratory protective devices to protect against particles (FFP1, FFP2, FFP3).

standards.title: Textiles - Requirements for Clothing to Protect Against Heat and Flame
standards.scope: Specifies performance requirements for garments made from flexible materials which are designed to protect the wearer's body from heat and/or flame.

standards.title: Textiles - Requirements for Protective Clothing for Workers Exposed to Radiant Heat and Molten Metal Splashes
standards.scope: Specifies requirements for performance of protective clothing worn by operators in foundries, steel plants, and blast furnaces.

standards.title: Industrial Safety Belts and Harnesses - Part 1: Full Body Harness
standards.scope: Specifies requirements, testing and marking for full body harnesses used as personal fall arrest systems.

standards.title: Industrial Safety Gloves - Leather Gloves - Specification
standards.scope: Specifies requirements for leather safety gloves intended to provide hand protection against mechanical risks and abrasion.

standards.title: Specification for Eye-Protectors
standards.scope: Covers functional requirements for eye-protectors (safety spectacles, goggles, face shields) to protect against optical radiation and flying particles.

standards.title: Guide for Selection of Industrial Safety Equipment for Body Protection
standards.scope: Provides guidance on selection of suitable protective equipment for protecting the torso and limbs against various hazards in industrial work environments.

standards.title: Safety Aspects Related to Mechanical and Physical Properties of Toys
standards.scope: Applies to all toys, including all products designed or intended, whether or not exclusively, for use in play by children under 14 years of age.

standards.title: Polyethylene for Its Safe Use in Contact with Foodstuffs, Pharmaceuticals and Drinking Water - Specification
standards.scope: Specifies requirements and methods of sampling and test for polyethylene plastic materials for manufacture of containers, closures, and wrappings coming in contact with foodstuffs.

standards.title: Positive List of Constituents of Polyethylene in Contact with Foodstuffs, Pharmaceuticals and Drinking Water
standards.scope: Lists polymers, additives, catalysts and emulsifying agents which may be safely used in the manufacture of polyethylene materials intended for food contact.

standards.title: Methods of Test for Polyethylene Moulding Materials and Polyethylene Compounds
standards.scope: Prescribes methods of test for density, melt flow index, carbon black content, and environmental stress crack resistance of polyethylene compounds.

standards.title: Determination of Overall Migration of Constituents of Plastics Materials and Articles Intended to Come into Contact with Foodstuffs - Method of Analysis
standards.scope: Prescribes methods of analysis for determination of overall migration from plastics materials and articles into various food simulants like water, heptane, and alcohol.

standards.title: Portable Fire Extinguishers - Performance and Construction - Specification
standards.scope: Specifies requirements for design, construction, testing and performance of portable fire extinguishers of water, foam, powder, and clean agent types.

standards.title: Selection, Installation and Maintenance of First-Aid Fire Extinguishers - Code of Practice
standards.scope: Covers recommendations for the selection, installation, maintenance and testing of first-aid portable and wheeled fire extinguishers.

standards.title: Plywood for General Purposes - Specification
standards.scope: Covers requirements of different grades of plywood for general purposes manufactured from timbers.

standards.title: Marine Plywood - Specification
standards.scope: Specifies requirements for marine plywood manufactured from superior quality wood veneers bonded with unextended phenol formaldehyde synthetic resin.

standards.title: Wooden Flush Door Shutters (Solid Core Type) - Part 1: Plywood Face Panels
standards.scope: Specifies requirements for solid core wooden flush door shutters with plywood face panels for residential and commercial buildings.

standards.title: Sluice Valves for Water Works Purposes (50 to 1200 mm Size) - Specification
standards.scope: Covers requirements for non-rising spindle and rising spindle sluice valves up to 1200 mm nominal bore for water supply works.

qco_orders.order_name: Steel and Steel Products (Quality Control) Order, 2020
qco_orders.penal_clause: Prohibits the manufacture, import, distribution, sale, or storage of listed steel products without BIS Standard Mark (ISI). Violations attract prosecution under Section 29 of the Bureau of Indian Standards Act, 2016.
qco_orders.scope_summary: All hot-rolled structural steel plates, sections, high-strength deformed rebar for RCC, and hollow steel tubes.

qco_orders.order_name: Electronics and Information Technology Goods (Requirement for Compulsory Registration) Order, 2021
qco_orders.ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)
qco_orders.penal_clause: No person shall manufacture, store for sale, import or distribute goods without self-declaration of conformity and registration under BIS Compulsory Registration Scheme (CRS).
qco_orders.scope_summary: Laptops, notebook computers, tablets, secondary lithium batteries, mobile phones, audio/video apparatus, and UPS systems.

qco_orders.order_name: Footwear made from Leather and other Materials (Quality Control) Order, 2022
qco_orders.ministry: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)
qco_orders.penal_clause: Mandatory conformity to Indian Standards with BIS ISI Mark under Section 16 of the BIS Act, 2016.
qco_orders.scope_summary: Industrial safety footwear, protective footwear, and industrial leather protective equipment.

qco_orders.ministry: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)
qco_orders.penal_clause: Toys manufactured or imported for children up to 14 years must bear the BIS Standard Mark under Scheme-I.
qco_orders.scope_summary: All physical, mechanical and non-electric toys manufactured or imported into India.

qco_orders.order_name: Solar Photovoltaics, Systems, Devices and Components Goods (Requirements for Compulsory Registration) Order, 2017
qco_orders.ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE)
qco_orders.penal_clause: Prohibits the storage, sale, or deployment of non-certified terrestrial PV modules in grid-connected or off-grid solar projects.
qco_orders.scope_summary: Crystalline silicon terrestrial photovoltaic modules, thin-film modules, and grid-tied inverters.

qco_orders.order_name: Polyethylene Material for Moulding and Extrusion (Quality Control) Order, 2022
qco_orders.penal_clause: Conformity to Indian Standard mandatory under Scheme-I with BIS ISI mark for all virgin and processed polymer resins.
qco_orders.scope_summary: High density polyethylene, low density polyethylene compounds for water pipes and food-contact packaging.

qco_orders.order_name: Electrical Wires, Cables and Appliances (Quality Control) Order, 2023
qco_orders.ministry: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)
qco_orders.penal_clause: Mandatory conformity assessment and BIS standard mark for all low-voltage building wires, plugs, sockets, and heavy-duty distribution cables.
qco_orders.scope_summary: PVC insulated copper wires, power distribution cables, and domestic wall plugs and sockets.

qco_orders.ministry: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)
qco_orders.penal_clause: Prohibits manufacturing, bagging, distributing or importing any type of cement without valid BIS Certification Mark.
qco_orders.scope_summary: Ordinary Portland Cement (Grades 33, 43, 53), Portland Pozzolana Cement, and Portland Slag Cement.

qco_orders.order_name: Personal Protective Equipment - Industrial Helmets (Quality Control) Order, 2021
qco_orders.ministry: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)
qco_orders.penal_clause: All safety helmets and full body harnesses supplied to industrial, mining, and construction sites must be BIS certified.
qco_orders.scope_summary: Industrial safety helmets, harnesses, and fall arresters.

qco_orders.order_name: Wood and Wood Products (Plywood and Wooden Flush Doors) Quality Control Order, 2023
qco_orders.ministry: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)
qco_orders.penal_clause: No person shall manufacture, import, distribute or sell plywood or flush door shutters without BIS standard mark.
qco_orders.scope_summary: General-purpose plywood, marine plywood, and solid core wooden flush door shutters.
